## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-8: Epic description updated with 'SC10 Evidence' subsection: PR URL, arbiter comment URL, DEFER orphan ticket ID, DROP defense record URL, BLOCK evidence (screenshot or commit ID).

Fetch epic b575-ac1c-f720-4839's current description; append (or replace, if it already exists) an `## SC10 Evidence` subsection containing five pointers harvested from task-1, task-2, and task-3 progress notes:
  (a) PR URL (from task-1's `PR:` note → https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/pull/<N>)
  (b) Arbiter PR comment URL (from task-2's `arbiter_comment_url:` note)
  (c) DEFER orphan ticket ID (from task-2's `orphan_ticket:` note)
  (d) DROP defense record commit URL OR PR comment URL (from task-2's `drop_defense_url:` note)
  (e) BLOCK demonstration — failed-check commit SHA OR screenshot reference (from task-2's `block_evidence:` note)
Write the updated description back via `.claude/scripts/dso ticket update b575-ac1c-f720-4839 --description ...`. Idempotency: if an `## SC10 Evidence` subsection already exists, replace it in place rather than appending a second one (so re-running this task does not create duplicate sections).

Note on test exemption: test-exempt — documentation/ticket-CLI invocation; no executable behavior under test.

## Acceptance Criteria

**Universal (always run):**
- [ ] Lint passes
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Tests pass
  Verify: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && bash tests/run-all.sh

**Task-specific:**
- [ ] dd-8: Epic description contains `## SC10 Evidence` heading
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show b575-ac1c-f720-4839 2>/dev/null | grep -q '## SC10 Evidence'
- [ ] dd-8: SC10 Evidence subsection contains PR URL pointer
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show b575-ac1c-f720-4839 2>/dev/null | awk '/^## SC10 Evidence/{flag=1; next} /^## /{flag=0} flag' | grep -qE 'https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/pull/[0-9]+'
- [ ] dd-8: SC10 Evidence subsection contains arbiter comment URL
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show b575-ac1c-f720-4839 2>/dev/null | awk '/^## SC10 Evidence/{flag=1; next} /^## /{flag=0} flag' | grep -qE 'https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/pull/[0-9]+#issuecomment-[0-9]+'
- [ ] dd-8: SC10 Evidence subsection contains DEFER orphan ticket ID
  Verify: ORPHAN=$(.claude/scripts/dso ticket show f4a0-fec6-b98c-46b0 | grep -oE 'orphan_ticket: [a-zA-Z0-9_-]+' | head -1 | awk '{print $2}'); .claude/scripts/dso ticket show b575-ac1c-f720-4839 2>/dev/null | awk '/^## SC10 Evidence/{flag=1; next} /^## /{flag=0} flag' | grep -q "$ORPHAN"
- [ ] dd-8: SC10 Evidence subsection contains DROP defense pointer
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show b575-ac1c-f720-4839 2>/dev/null | awk '/^## SC10 Evidence/{flag=1; next} /^## /{flag=0} flag' | grep -qE 'DEFENSE_RECORD|defense_record_url'
- [ ] dd-8: SC10 Evidence subsection contains BLOCK evidence (screenshot path OR commit SHA)
  Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show b575-ac1c-f720-4839 2>/dev/null | awk '/^## SC10 Evidence/{flag=1; next} /^## /{flag=0} flag' | grep -qE 'block_evidence|BLOCK|[0-9a-f]{7,40}'
- [ ] dd-8: Exactly one `## SC10 Evidence` section exists (idempotent replace, not append)
  Verify: [ "$(.claude/scripts/dso ticket show b575-ac1c-f720-4839 2>/dev/null | grep -c '^## SC10 Evidence$')" = "1" ]
